name: Motora
tagline: Your vehicle's digital logbook — fuel, service, and expenses
description: Motora is a private service book for your vehicles. Log every fill-up, service, and expense in seconds, and keep the full history of each car or bike in one place — the kind of record that pays for itself when something needs proving.

It works entirely offline. There is no account to create and nothing is uploaded, so your registration details, mileage, and spending stay on your phone. Set your own currency and units, get a reminder before insurance or a service falls due, and keep a backup file you can carry to a new phone.
features: Log fuel, service, expenses, and reminders in seconds
A running timeline of everything each vehicle has been through
Reminders by date or by distance, so nothing lapses
Fuel efficiency and spending trends over time
Your currency, your units — rupees or dollars, kilometres or miles
Fully offline: no account, no sync, no tracking
Back up and restore your whole logbook as a single file
Keep insurance and registration documents on your phone, not in a drawer
Light and dark themes, or just follow your device
Multiple vehicles, each with its own record

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.reason: Used only to deliver the reminders you set yourself, scheduled on the device. Motora does not use push notifications, so no messages are ever sent to it from a server.

permissions.name: Storage
permissions.reason: Used only when you pick a file yourself — a document to attach, or a backup to save or restore. Documents you attach are copied into Motora's own private storage on the device. Motora reads and writes nothing on its own, and never scans your files.

privacy.dataDeletionNote: Everything you record stays in Motora's own storage on your device. Deleting a vehicle removes its records, 'Delete all records' in Settings › Backup and restore clears everything at once, and uninstalling the app removes all of it. Any backup file you chose to save stays wherever you saved it, under your control. Because nothing is ever uploaded, there is no copy for us to delete.

name: TinySteps
tagline: Every moment matters — feeding, sleep, growth, and health in one place
description: TinySteps is a baby tracker for the first years, when the days blur together and the details still matter. Log a feed, a nap, a diaper, a dose of medicine, or a growth measurement in a few taps, and get back a clear picture of the day instead of a notebook full of guesses.

Everything lives on your phone first, so the app works with no signal and no account. A single timeline pulls every module together, insights chart weight and height against percentiles as they come in, and reminders keep vaccinations, medicine, and doctor visits from slipping. Sign in only if you want a cloud backup you can restore onto a new phone.
features: Feeding log — breast, bottle, and solids, with a running Today summary
Sleep sessions with start/stop tracking and daily totals
Diaper, medicine, and dose-by-dose medication history
Growth measurements with weight, height, and head circumference charts
Vaccination schedule with reminders generated automatically
Doctor visits and a baby profile with blood group, allergies, and emergency contacts
One timeline across every module, with filters, search, and swipe actions
Works fully offline — no account needed to use any screen
Optional cloud backup and restore when you sign in
Light and dark themes that follow your device

dataCollected.type: Email address (only if you create an account)
dataCollected.purpose: Used solely to sign you in so your records can be backed up and restored. Handled by Supabase Auth. TinySteps works fully without an account, and no email is collected if you stay offline.

dataCollected.type: Baby records you enter (feeding, sleep, diaper, medicine, growth, vaccination, doctor visits, baby profile)
dataCollected.purpose: Stored locally on your device. If — and only if — you sign in, these records are also copied to your own private rows in the cloud database so you can restore them on a new phone. Row-level security means no other user can read them.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.reason: Used only to deliver the reminders you set for medicine, vaccinations, and doctor visits. Scheduled on the device — TinySteps does not send push messages from a server.

thirdPartyServices.name: Supabase (authentication and cloud backup, used only if you sign in)

privacy.dataDeletionNote: All records live in TinySteps' own storage on your device. Deleting an entry removes it, and uninstalling the app or clearing its storage removes everything local. If you signed in for backup, signing out stops any further upload, and you can ask us to delete your account and every backed-up row by writing to the contact address on this page.

name: Fuel Tracker
tagline: Log fuel fills in seconds and see your mileage, spending and cost per km.
description: Fuel Tracker is a simple, fast log for your car's fuel. Record a fill-up in a few seconds: pick the date, type the odometer reading and any two of amount, price per litre and litres, and the app works out the third for you.

Mileage (km/L) is calculated for every fill from your odometer readings, and everything is recalculated in date order, so you can add older fills at any time. Missing a value? Save what you know and complete it later. Each person has their own account, with no ads and no tracking.
features: Add a fuel fill in about 10 seconds with a native date picker and number keyboards
Enter any two of amount, price and litres; the third is calculated
Mileage in km/L for every fill, worked out from odometer readings
Add old fills in any order; everything is recalculated by date
Save incomplete entries and finish them later
History grouped by month, with view, edit and delete
Statistics: total running, fuel, spending, average mileage, average price and cost per km
Running and mileage charts, in light and dark mode

dataCollected.purpose: Used to create your account and sign you in. Stored on the Fuel Tracker server, never shared or sold. Your password is stored only as a one-way hash.

dataCollected.type: Fuel entries (date, odometer reading, amount paid, price per litre, litres)
dataCollected.purpose: The records you enter, used to calculate your mileage and statistics. Stored on the Fuel Tracker server, visible only to your account, and kept until you delete them.

dataCollected.type: Security records (user number and IP address)
dataCollected.purpose: The server logs sign-ins and changes to protect accounts against abuse. Your email address is not written into these logs, and they are deleted automatically after 12 months.

permissions.name: Internet access
permissions.reason: Used to sign you in and to save and load your fuel entries over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection.

privacy.dataDeletionNote: Open the app, tap the account icon at the top right of Home, then Delete account. This permanently deletes your account and all your fuel entries immediately. You can also delete single entries at any time, or use the deletion page at https://132-226-190-156.sslip.io/fuel-tracker/delete-account.html.

name: ReadRhythm
tagline: A quiet reading log — pages, streaks and finish dates
description: ReadRhythm is a quiet reading log. Add the books you are reading, log the pages after each sitting, and see how your reading adds up — a finish date that follows your own pace, a streak, and analytics for every week.

It uses the same account as the ReadRhythm website, so your shelf is already there when you sign in. A log you make with no connection waits on your phone and is sent when you are back online. Free, with no ads and no tracking.
features: Log pages in seconds, for today or any earlier day
Log offline — it syncs when you are back online
A finish date predicted from your own reading pace
Daily page goal and reading streak on the dashboard
Your shelf: want to read, reading, finished or paused
Search Google Books to add a book with its cover, author and page count
Reading calendar and analytics by day, week and weekday
Badges to earn as you read
Optional gentle reminders and a weekly recap, planned on your phone
Download your data or delete your account from Settings

dataCollected.purpose: Used to create your account and sign you in. Stored on the ReadRhythm server, never shared or sold. Your password is stored only as a one-way hash.

dataCollected.type: Books, reading logs, reviews, badges and notifications you add
dataCollected.purpose: The records you enter, used to show your progress, streak and finish dates. Stored on the ReadRhythm server, visible only to your account, and kept until you delete them. The app also keeps a copy on your phone so it works offline.

dataCollected.type: Sign-in records (IP address and browser details)
dataCollected.purpose: The server records each sign-in to keep accounts secure. They are kept with the sign-in until it expires, then cleared out. They are not used for anything else and are not shared.

permissions.name: Internet access
permissions.reason: Used to sign you in and to save and load your books and reading logs over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.reason: Used only to show the optional reminders and weekly recap you turn on. They are worked out and scheduled on your phone; nothing about them is sent to a server.

thirdPartyServices.name: Google Books (book search and cover images)

privacy.dataDeletionNote: Open the app, go to Settings, then Danger zone, type DELETE and choose Delete account. This removes your profile, books, reading logs, reviews, badges and notifications. Your profile picture file and sign-in records are cleared out later by the site owner. Uninstalling the app removes what it keeps on your phone. You can also see https://read.abhijithkm.space/delete-account, or write to meabhijithkm@gmail.com.
